phases.name: Onboarding & Baseline
phases.focus: Assess movement, establish technique, and set glycaemic-friendly routines

phases.name: Foundation Strength
phases.focus: Build total-body strength and aerobic base to improve insulin sensitivity

phases.name: Progressive Overload
phases.focus: Increase training stress with structured volume and intensity for fat loss

phases.name: Consolidation & Taper
phases.focus: Deload, maintain habits, and solidify glycaemic control

non_negotiables: Check blood glucose before, during if needed, and after sessions
Coordinate metformin timing with meals per prescriber
Hydrate before, during, and after training
Stop exercise if symptomatic hypo or hyperglycaemia
Prioritize proper footwear and foot checks
Progress loads conservatively and maintain strict form
Warm up and cool down every session
Monitor and record glucose, energy, and recovery daily
Use full-gym equipment safely with spotters where appropriate

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary body_composition:
    name "Fat loss with improved glycaemic control for T2D on metformin"
PHASES
  PHASE "Onboarding & Baseline" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
          leg_swings 2m
          hip_circles 2m
          bodyweight squat 3m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m
          child_pose 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 55m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2m
          band face_pull 3m
          scapular_retraction 2m
          wrist_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Cardio Intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          dynamic leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 8x1 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          calf_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full-Body Strength":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3m
          hip_circles 2m
          cat_cow 2m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

          back_stretch 2m
